### Gate campaign leads for compliant follow-up

Checks consent, suppression, geography, engagement, and target-account status before campaign follow-up.

**Production gate:** this inactive template uses an unauthenticated webhook for local testing only. Configure built-in webhook authentication, review policy version 1.0.0, and assign a human owner before activation.
